title: KB-GRAPH-2: wire kb_graph_query into the KB-first contract (researcher + orchestrator-routing)
description: From the 2026-07-18 intake+KB-graph design review (Q2, recommended path step 2). Once kb_graph_query exists (TASK-168), make it a first-class step: update .claude/agents/researcher.md and the orchestrator-routing SKILL.md KB-first contract so agents CALL kb_graph_query alongside kb_lookup before web search (the same 'query first, then web' precedence already documented for the external brain) instead of 'read graph.json by hand'. comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: NOTE (follows TASK-168's merge-seam refinement): when wiring kb_graph_query into the KB-first contract, describe its behavior as canonical-first-then-local (brain when opted in, local projection by default) rather than 'local graph only'. The doc should make clear the tool is the single query surface in BOTH modes, so agents call it regardless of whether the brain is up. Keep the external brain framed as opt-in/experimental (do not imply it is on by default).
